actors.name: Resident
actors.private_context: The resident has been experiencing ongoing issues with neighbors (e.g., noise, disputes) and hopes for improvement. They are considering possible actions but have not yet decided on any specific approach.

actors.name: Neighbors
actors.private_context: The neighbors are aware of some tension but have their own perspectives and routines. They may or may not be open to improving relations.

shared_context: There is a history of minor conflicts between the resident and the neighbors (e.g., noise complaints, boundary disagreements). Both parties live in close proximity and interact occasionally. No formal complaints or mediation have been initiated as of the start time.

starting_events.description: The current situation between the resident and the neighbors is as described in shared_context.

resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-11-01T12:00:00+02:00, the persistent event history shows a clear, observable improvement in the relationship (e.g., a friendly interaction, a resolved dispute, a mutual agreement, or a sustained reduction in conflicts). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
